Whiteboard race

One player from each team stands by the whiteboard, marker down. A picture appears. First to pick up the marker writes the idiom.

  1. Correct and spelt right: 1 point. Press +1 for that team.
  2. Wrong or misspelt: the other player writes. Right: they take the point.
  3. Then Reveal, and everyone says it out loud. Next for two new players.
